name: Transco 85 North Expansion Phase II
researcher_notes: New expansion row, not an existing row under another name: no 85 North row in the US gas roster (nearest are P2544 Hillabee Phase 2 and P2574 Northeast Supply Enhancement, both different projects). A Federal Register notice from July 7, 2009 (FERC docket CP09-57) describes three 42 inch loops totaling about 22.06 miles: Coosa Loop 4.40 mi in Alabama, Cowpens Loop 9.39 mi in South Carolina, and Iredell Loop 8.27 mi in Iredell and Rowan Counties, North Carolina. The EIA pipeline projects release dated August 2026 (sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 686) lists Phase 2 as Completed 2011-04-27 with 22 miles, 42 inch, 218.5 MMcf/d added, cost 148 million dollars. A Williams Partners press release from July 12, 2010 gives about 22 miles of 42 inch pipe in Alabama, South Carolina and North Carolina, 218,500 dekatherms a day added, and an expected 2011 start. The press release's 241 million dollar figure covers both phases, so the 148 million EIA figure is used for this segment. The press release and EIA are weak on independence from each other, the Federal Register notice is separate. Start month and year come from EIA only. The owner is Transco, a Williams subsidiary; style copied from the existing Transco rows. Phase 1 (compression only, 90 MMcf/d, EIA row 650) is not a pipe row and is not proposed. Length is 22.06 miles (about 35.5 km), above the 25 km threshold. No route research done; no route type or accuracy proposed. The three loops are separate pieces, so a route would need three segments. The Federal Register notice is the planned scope; EIA confirms completion with the same 22 miles.
